sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.scale: 1" = 59'-0" (Overall West Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall South Elevation); 1" = 29'-0" (Overall East Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall North Elevation)
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-201 contains four overall exterior elevations (North, South, East, West) for an industrial building for Crow Holdings located on Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Scales vary per elevation: West 1"=59'-0", South 1"=49'-0", East 1"=29'-0", North 1"=49'-0". Key elevation heights noted at TI panel at entry (44'-2"), TI panel (42'-2"), finish floor (0'-0"), and truck court (-4'-0"). Overhead dock doors are visible on West and East elevations (labeled RO). Entry storefront glazing appears at multiple bays on all elevations. Exterior finish schedule identifies five painted concrete texture coatings (TBD colors), aluminum storefront, pre-finished metal, and pre-engineered canopy elements. Quantities for glazing, canopy, and finish areas cannot be precisely extracted from this elevation sheet without associated dimensions and area calculations. Glass note: projects within 1 mile of coastal mean high water line must have impact-rated glass in wind-borne debris regions. Drawing is NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION as of issue date 02/25/2025, with revisions dated through 01 April 2021 at 95% design review.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is a miscellaneous details sheet for Crow Holdings Industrial - Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Sheet contains 13 details at various scales including: dock leveler (future) sections and plans (Details 1-3), ramp rail section (Detail 4), pump/electrical room section (Detail 5), stair plan (Detail 6), typical bollard (Detail 7), stair rail (Detail 8), Z-guard detail (Detail 9), stair section (Detail 10), fire riser/electrical panel protection (Detail 11), ramp w/landing section (Detail 12), and enlarged ramp plan (Detail 13). All dock leveler details are labeled FUTURE. Sheet is marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION. Job No. 38079. Issued 06/2025. Most quantities are not enumerated on this detail sheet; quantities to be taken off from floor plan and schedule sheets.
